text:
morgan (sre): Quick announcement: planned maintenance window for capacity rebalancing and a short failover drill next Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC. Objective: reduce long-tail p99s during nightly compactions. No customer SLA changes.

ash (oncall): will this generate pages? what's the noise plan? :thinking:

morgan (sre): We will mute routine node-drain alerts and only page if error-rate > 0.8% for 3m or p99 > 150ms for 5m. We'll also create a temporary suppression for autoscaling events.

viv (infra): rollout order: eu-west-1 canary -> us-west-2 -> us-east-1. We'll move unallocated reserved nodes first and avoid touching active Dedicated tenants. Pre-warm kv-caches for VIP routes.

kelly (prod-eng): please notify Dedicated customers with active monthly commits, just a short console banner and optional email. Use the maintenance template.

ops-bot: Notification draft saved and scheduled: 48h + 1h reminders. Calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/maint-1977770000. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/rebalance-2026.

ash (oncall): runbook link? want quick rollback steps in the thread in case the canary shows issues.

morgan (sre): rollback: revert pool assignments, reattach routes, re-enable autoscaling. If both error-rate and p99 cross thresholds, open incident and escalate to oncall@redwood.ai. Runbook snippet added to ops page.

viv (infra): will disable aggressive autoscaler policies during the window and run bgp/convergence checks after each AZ move. Also scheduling note: each AZ batch ~15m.

kelly (prod-eng): I'll run synthetics at T+5m and T+20m and post results here. If we see P99 > 100ms we pause.

morgan (sre): action items: 1) @viv attach final checklist 2) @kelly queue notifications 3) @ash hold pages per thresholds. Closing thread; will post post-maint metrics in #eng-sre after verification. :white_check_mark:
